messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: building CFA model
parts:
It would seem that you have loaded another package (after loading
lavaan) that also includes a cfa() function, but with totally different
arguments.

To call the 'lavaan' version, use lavaan:::cfa() instead of cfa().

I do wonder which package this is? Could you give us the output of

sessionInfo()

Yves.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: building CFA model
parts:
On 12/18/22 08:16, Yves Rosseel wrote:
> I do wonder which package this is?

It is the cfa() function of the sem package.

As a general rule: better not load both the sem and lavaan packages in
the same R session.

Yves.
